A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the dose distribution of a monoenergetic charged particle beam incident on a thick inhomogeneity depends primarily on the ratio of the inhomogeneity length to the range of the particles in the medium and on the angular spread of the beam.

the dose distribution in a homogeneous medium is not significantly altered if the beam is incident on a thin inhomogeneous medium, but that the dose distribution is significantly altered if the inhomogeneous medium extends for a substantial portion (greater than 1/4 the range) of the particle range.
the influence of a thick inhomogeneity depends on the angular divergence and the range of the incident charged particle.
